about: Story scenes of Volume 1, chapter 1, Peach Blossom Ford: the dream of the Withering, the ruined Pavilion, and Su Lianhua joining (draft).

lines.text: A garden without end, beside a pool of jade. A hundred flowers grow there, and beneath each flower sleeps the shadow of a woman.
Then the sky above Kunlun cracks like a bowl, and black fire begins to fall.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Where am I?
A girl's voice answers, from everywhere and nowhere at once.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Home.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Don't be frightened. This already happened, a very long time ago. But you'll have to fight it anyway.

Four women step out from among the flowers: one in plum white with a sword of frost, one in violet with lightning between her fingers, one in vermilion with fire at her sleeves, and one in jade green carrying a lotus lamp.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Stay behind me. Whatever comes through that smoke, it does not touch you.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Wraiths. Hundreds of them.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Only hundreds? Good! I was getting bored of watering things.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: You never water anything, Phoenix. You set the watering can on fire.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Enough, Night-Bloom. They're here.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Listen to me. Water feeds Wood, Wood feeds Fire, and Fire makes Earth. Let them strike in that order, and each one's Dao will lift the next.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: That is Harmony. The whole Garden grew from it.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: You heard her. Plum, Night-Bloom, Phoenix, Lotus. As always.
The wraiths pour over the white stones of the pool.
The last wraith comes apart like wet paper. For one heartbeat, the Garden is quiet.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: Ha! Is that all the Netherworld has?
It is not. Overhead, the black fire opens like an eye.

lines.speaker: npc:netherflame_sovereign
lines.text: A hundred flowers. A hundred seeds. I will swallow every one.

lines.speaker: hero:ling_shuang
lines.text: Then you will choke.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: The pool is burning... Go! We'll hold him here. All of us.

lines.speaker: hero:mo_yingyue
lines.text: Don't make that face. You'll find us again. You always find us.

lines.speaker: hero:yan_feihong
lines.text: And don't take a thousand years about it!
White, violet, vermilion and jade, the four flowers blaze up together, and the fire takes them.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Not again... Wake up. Please, wake up!
The Garden burns. Someone you cannot see is holding your hand, and will not let go.
You wake on cold stone, under a roof with more holes than tiles. Morning light falls through them onto a hall full of dust and dead leaves.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Awake at last! You climbed every one of those mountain steps last night just to fall asleep on the floor of the main hall. And you talked in your sleep. Something about fire?

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: That voice... You were in my dream.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Was I?

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Then I must be very memorable! I'm Tao Yao, steward of the Hundred Blossoms Pavilion. Welcome home, Pavilion Master!

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Pavilion Master?

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Mm-hm. The rule here is very simple: whoever the Fate Lotus opens for is the master. And last night, it opened for you.
In the middle of the hall lies a round pond, dry and cracked. On a stone at its centre rests a lotus of pale jade, no bigger than two cupped hands.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: The Fate Pond, and the Fate Lotus. The Pavilion's two great treasures. One of them is currently full of dead leaves.
As you look at the Lotus, its petals stir. Threads of red light spill from its heart, thin as hair, running out through the broken walls in every direction.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: You can see them, can't you? Threads of fate. Every one of them ends at someone the Pavilion is meant to find.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Light a stick of Fate Incense by the pond and follow a thread. If the one at the other end hears you, she'll come. That's how the Pavilion grew, once.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Once?

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Oh, a while ago. The roof was nicer then.
Before you can ask anything more, one thread pulls tight, hot as a coal. Through the broken doors, far down the mountain, a column of smoke climbs over the river.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: That's Peach Blossom Ford. The orchards... Something down there is burning.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: And that thread points straight at it. Light the incense first, Pavilion Master. Whoever answers, you'll want her beside you when we go down.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: We?

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Naturally! Someone has to show you the road. And carry the snacks.
Peach Blossom Ford is burning. Ferry boats smoulder at their moorings, and grey shapes drift between the houses, setting the thatch alight with a touch.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_he
lines.text: This way! Everyone to the Jade Lotus Temple! Leave the carts, leave the pigs, just run!

lines.speaker: npc:chief_he
lines.text: You there! Did you come down from the old Pavilion? Then for pity's sake, help us! Those things don't bleed!

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Wraiths... real ones. Pavilion Master, they've seen us.

lines.speaker: npc:seer_bai
lines.text: No need to hurry so, Chief. The fire won't reach the temple.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_he
lines.text: Old Bai, you're blind! How would you know?

lines.speaker: npc:seer_bai
lines.text: I'm blind, not deaf. I can hear who just walked into the village.
As one, the wraiths turn toward you.
In the square before the temple road, the refugees huddle under a dome of green light shaped like an opening lotus. A young nun holds it up alone. Her arms are shaking.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Stay under the petals, all of you. Grandmother Wang, hold the children's hands. No one steps outside.
Black-robed figures circle the shield while their wraiths claw at its edge. Wherever the claws strike, the jade light cracks.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: You... you're not with them. Your Qi is clean.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: I am Su Lianhua of the Jade Lotus Temple. If you mean to help, I won't refuse you. If you get hurt, I'll tend you afterwards.
For an instant, a red thread flickers between her hand and yours. She doesn't seem to see it.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Who are they?

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Black robes, grey fire, wraiths on leashes. The Netherflame Sect. The abbess used to tell us stories about them. I thought they were only stories.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: They're not.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Then we fight. I'll keep the shield over the villagers. You keep them off the shield.
At the riverbank, an old man in a straw cape sits staring at an empty mooring post.

lines.speaker: npc:ferryman_liu
lines.text: Forty years I've poled that ferry across this river. Forty years! And now look at it. Gone.

lines.speaker: npc:ferryman_liu
lines.text: Not burned, mind you. Dragged under! River ghouls, all stirred up by those grey devils. They hauled my boat off to the reed beds like a dog with a bone.

lines.speaker: npc:chief_he
lines.text: Without Liu's ferry, the refugees can't cross to the far bank. The bridge burned an hour ago.

lines.speaker: npc:ferryman_liu
lines.text: You look like you know which end of a fight to hold. Bring my boat back, and I'll carry every soul in this village across. Free! Well. Free today.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: That's a very generous discount.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: We'll bring it back.

lines.speaker: npc:ferryman_liu
lines.text: Ha! Mind the reeds. Ghouls like to grab ankles.
The ferry bobs back to its mooring: muddy, scratched, smelling powerfully of river ghoul, but afloat.

lines.speaker: npc:ferryman_liu
lines.text: My girl! Look at her, not a plank missing! Well, one plank. Two.

lines.speaker: npc:ferryman_liu
lines.text: All aboard! Children first, then grandmothers, then anyone who can swim if it comes to that.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Thank you, all of you. The temple won't forget this.

lines.speaker: npc:ferryman_liu
lines.text: Here, take these. My wife's lotus seed cakes. She made them for the spring festival, and there won't be a festival now. Better someone eats them.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Lotus seed cakes... Oh. Those are my favourite.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Pavilion Master, I think you've just found the quickest road to a healer's heart.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: That isn't... I mean... Please just make sure everyone gets across safely!
Halfway up the temple road, a cart piled high with pots, scrolls and bundles of who-knows-what blocks the way. A round man in a silk cap waves from the top of it.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Customers! In the middle of a disaster! Heaven still loves Old Qian.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Myriad Treasures Guild, at your service. Lamp oil, bandages, wraith-warding talismans, only slightly expired. Everything a hero needs.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Shouldn't you be running away? The village is on fire.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Young miss, the Guild sends me wherever things are on fire. Burning villages need buckets, and buckets need a seller.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Between us, the Guild's auction house sold a "dragon's tooth" last month that was very obviously a cow's. Madam Jin made me swear not to tell anyone. So I'm only telling everyone.

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: And here's some free gossip, since you look honest. Someone has been buying up every Yin-aspected herb in three provinces. Pays in black jade and never haggles. Never haggles! That's not a customer, that's an omen.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Who?

lines.speaker: npc:old_qian
lines.text: Black robes, a polite smile, smells of dry earth. That's all I know, and more than I wanted to. Now, can I interest you in a bucket?
From the temple steps you can see the whole valley. The peach orchards are burning row by row, their blossoms going up like sparks.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Oh... the peach trees.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Sorry! I just like peach trees. They remember everything, you know.

lines.speaker: npc:abbess_huiming
lines.text: They burn the orchards, but they do not come for the temple. They are not looting. They are calling.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Calling me. I can feel it, Abbess. With every tree that burns, they're saying my name.

lines.speaker: npc:abbess_huiming
lines.text: Since you were small, lotuses have opened wherever you knelt to heal. I prayed no one else would ever notice.

lines.speaker: npc:abbess_huiming
lines.text: Pavilion Master. I am an old nun, and I have no right to ask anything of you. I ask anyway. Protect her.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Abbess, there are farmers in that grove! I won't hide behind these walls while people burn for my sake.

lines.speaker: npc:abbess_huiming
lines.text: I know, child. That is why I am asking them to go with you, not to keep you here.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: She won't be alone.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Thank you. Then let's go. Mud does not stain the lotus, and neither will smoke.
At the heart of the burning grove stands a figure twice the height of a man: an old general's armour, empty of everything but netherflame, gripping a halberd of black iron.
When it speaks, its voice is the crackle of wet wood on a fire. "The healer. The seed. Give them to the flame."

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: It's looking at me. Not at my face. At something inside me.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: A seed? What seed? What does it want from me?

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Questions later! Fight now!

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: That's the Wraith Captain. It led the raid. Pavilion Master, if it falls, the rest will scatter.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Then it falls. I'll keep you standing for as long as it takes.

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Together.
The Captain raises its halberd, and the whole grove bows toward it in flame.
The Wraith Captain's armour falls apart piece by piece, and the netherflame inside it gutters out like a candle in the rain. All across the valley, the wraiths fade with it.
Among the ashes where it stood lies a token of black jade, carved with a withered branch.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: A withered branch... Keep that, Pavilion Master. Someone sent that thing here.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Pavilion Master, the lotus at your belt. It's glowing.

The Fate Lotus opens in your hand. A red thread runs from its heart to Su Lianhua's, and where it touches her, something answers: a seed of light deep in her chest, unfolding like a lotus on still water.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: I've felt this before, in dreams. A pool of jade, and a garden, and fire...

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: And you were there. Have we met?

lines.speaker: npc:pavilion_master
lines.text: Lotus.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: ...No one has ever called me that. Why does it sound like my name?

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: Because the Lotus knows its own. Your Dao Seed is waking, Su Lianhua. That's what the Netherflame Sect could smell on the wind.

lines.speaker: npc:abbess_huiming
lines.text: Then the temple pond was always too small for you, child.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Abbess, the refugees, the wounded...

lines.speaker: npc:abbess_huiming
lines.text: Have sisters of their own to care for them. Take the old lotus lantern from the shrine. It has waited a long time for someone to carry it out of the gate.

lines.speaker: npc:abbess_huiming
lines.text: Go with the Pavilion Master. If they mean to hunt you, better they find you among friends.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Then I'll go. Pavilion Master, I am Su Lianhua of the Jade Lotus Temple, and from today, of the Hundred Blossoms Pavilion.

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Now hold still. Let me tend your wounds first.

lines.speaker: npc:tao_yao
lines.text: One Blossom found! Only ninety-nine to go!

lines.speaker: hero:su_lianhua
lines.text: Ninety-nine?
Far to the north, a new thread of fate pulls tight, cold as snow.
